turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Why did Owen find out from the gradebook on his phone?
That isn't an answer. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Hale, "mm-hm" is not something I can write down. Either answer me or I take this to the principal today.
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.
"You stopped listening about five minutes ago." You asked for this meeting. The zero comes off Owen's essay, and I want that in writing.
